title: CENSUS-HWR: a large training dataset for offline handwriting recognition
reasoning: The paper introduces a new handwriting recognition dataset (CENSUS-HWR) extracted from US census records. While a referenced dataset (IAM) used a text corpus (LOB) that included texts on 'religion', the CENSUS-HWR paper itself does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics. Its focus is on the dataset's size, diversity of handwriting styles, and its utility for deep learning algorithms in handwriting recognition.
